```{r}

library(signal)
t <- seq(0, 1, len = 100)
sig <- sin(2 * pi * t)
ggplot(mapping = aes(t, sig)) + 
  geom_line()

 
#rnorm is function used to addthe ramdon numbers from a normal distribution
noisySig <- sin(2 * pi * t) + 0.25 * rnorm(length(t))
ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(t, noisySig), color = "red")



```

```{r}
# return a filtered sigal - noise smoothed out
# rest f code is just to plto 3 values
# need to understand , 1, and 0.1
butterFilter <- butter(4, 0.2)			 	
recoveredSig <- filter(butterFilter, noisySig)
allSignals <- data.frame(t,
                         sig,
                         noisySig,
                         recoveredSig)
ggplot(allSignals, aes(t)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = sig,
                color = "Original")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = noisySig,
                color = "Noisy")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = recoveredSig,
                color = "Recovered")) + 
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Signal")


```
